The '''evacuation of Dubrillion''' occurred early in the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==The battle==
Shortly after their arrival on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa Solo]] and [[Senator/Legends|Senator]] [[Elegos A'Kla]] began helping [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]] evacuate the populace of Dubrillion. The evacuation would have been impossible, were it not for the donation of dozens of evacuation ships by the [[Agamarian Council]]. As the evacuation commenced in earnest, [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Traest Kre'fey]] arrived with his [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the ''[[Ralroost]]'', and [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] to help defend the evacuation convoy from Yuuzhan Vong forces stationed in the [[Dubrillion system/Legends|system's]] [[Lando's Folly|asteroid belt]]. Calrissian also provided Kre'fey with two squadrons of [[Ugly/Legends|Ugly]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] to help defend the convoy.

As the convoy began to move out, a [[Miid ro'ik]] warship emerged from the asteroid belt, escorted by [[Squadron/Legends|squadrons]] of [[Yorik-et|Coralskippers]]. The Coralskippers immediately began strafing runs on the convoy and combat traffic controllers on the ''Ralroost'' quickly ordered Dubrillion's fighters to intercept them. Meanwhile the larger Yuuzhan Vong [[Warship/Legends|warship]] opened fire on the convoy and succeeded in destroying at least one evacuation [[Freighter/Legends|freighter]]. After receiving orders from the ''Ralroost'', [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Gavin Darklighter]] led Rogue Squadron in an attack on the [[Miid ro'ik]]. New squadron member and [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] Jaina Solo, working with wingperson [[Anni Capstan]], managed to deal light damage to the Yuuzhan Vong warship before being forced to withdraw.

After the first few evacuation ships escaped, the Yuuzhan Vong used their [[Dovin basal]]s to prevent the remaining New Republic vessels from escaping on their predetermined hyperspace route. Unable to fall back to [[Agamar/Legends|Agamar]], the remaining New Republic forces instead fled to [[Dantooine/Legends|Dantooine]]. The Yuuzhan Vong then proceeded to invade and occupy Dubrillion.
